{{Top|leg}}
A '''robo-delivery truck''' was an automated, unmanned vehicle used mainly in [[City/Legends|urban]] areas to perform small delivery operations. Depending on the model's internal guidance mechanism and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] capacity, they could be pre-programmed to perform their primary tasks. In some cases, they were remotely controlled through radio-transmitted instructions to the vehicles computer. As with all computer-automated vehicles, the robo-delivery truck was monitored by [[Traffic Central]].
